status: PROVISIONAL MECHANISM SCREEN; NOT FATIGUE OR STRUCTURAL CERTIFICATION
source_load: INERTIA_LOAD_SCREEN.json; baseline12.5g blade and uniform chord mass assumption,2640RPM, no aero/friction/jam loads
web_assumption: Two uninterrupted rectangular1.7x5.4mm webs. This excludes boss fillets, holes, recesses, local load entry and shear/torsional interaction; not a verified minimum-section/FEA result.
pin_rating_source: https://www.spirol.com/assets/files/cldp-coiled-spring-pins-design-guide-us.pdf printed17 ISO8750D1; supplier ultimate-type test value, not allowable fatigue stress
pin_limits: No reserve factor claimed: actual load sharing with D-flat, bending, press fit/host damage, axial pullout and cyclic duty are unverified. Installed solid reference is not actual coiled-section mass/geometry.
tube_E_assumption: No actual modulus assigned. Euler pinned-pinned full tube length; required modulus for3x inertial-force screen only; end bonds, compression damage and imperfections require qualification. Three is a proposed screening multiplier, not approved design factor.
bond_limits: No adhesive selected/qualified. Average shear ignores peel, end effects, preparation, gap, cure, fatigue and temperature. Tube insertion2.5mm preserved.
release_holds: Approve operating/aerodynamic/imbalance/stop load cases and required cycles
Define metal trunnion and its bond into specified blade spar/core; monolithic Part1 is only a geometry proxy
Assess drilled D3 trunnion fatigue and actual D-flat/hole geometry; undrilled torsion formula is not applicable as acceptance criterion
Verify actual twin-web minimum sections, boss/fillet stress and combined loading
Qualify pin press retention, adhesive pullout/cyclic fatigue, joint wear and anti-loosening
Guarded physical proof, balance/vibration and staged speed validation
